components/papathemes/socialproof/recent: {{!-- Papathemes Social Proof — Recent Sales mini popup shell. Rendered once globally in base.html before footer.scripts. JS in assets/js/theme/papathemes/socialproof/recentSales.js fills contents after fetching products via Storefront GraphQL. Storefront API token is deliberately NOT rendered as a DOM attribute here — base.html already injects it into the JS runtime context as `context.graphQLToken` (see `{{~inject 'graphQLToken' settings.storefront_api.token}}`). Reading it from the JS context avoids duplicating the token into server-rendered markup where it would be easier to scrape. --}}
